column1: # SQL fact counters: one per line, label TAB pattern (Java regex). srcmorph counts the pattern's
# matches over the whole source file and writes them as exact facts before the AI summary.
# Statements are counted where they start a line, case-insensitive, for PostgreSQL, MySQL and
# T-SQL. "VALUES rows (approx)" counts the row tuples of VALUES lists (a tuple after VALUES or
# after "),"), so a multi-row INSERT counts every row; rows an INSERT ... SELECT reads from a
# table are not seen, and a tuple nested inside a row counts once more. SqlFactPatternsTest
